card.fires_on: Small linking words, punctuation or word pieces where the next word likely starts with "Br" or "br", such as brain, bridge or Brain. Examples are "your" before body, "of" in March of Dimes, and "and" before darkest.

modes.label: Linking words
modes.description: Short words like your, to, of, and, or a comma where a Br- word may follow.

modes.label: Partway through names
modes.description: Inside a longer name or URL where the next piece could begin with a Br- sound.

card.writes: It raises word starts beginning with Br and lowers starts beginning with Tri or tr.
